unit.why: Within a halakhic note on a thirteen-branched menorah, the text gives a short hagiographic anecdote. The Maggid of Kozhnitz sees the menorah that R. Avraham (Abish), later rabbi of Frankfurt, installed in the synagogue of Karov, and perceives a great light shining from it. The passage adds that Elijah was revealed to R. Avraham.
unit.boundary_note: closes the section 'מענין מנורה'; next division begins a new letter-section

stories.start_quote: הגה״ק צי״ע וכו' המפורסם הרב ר׳ בערוש
stories.summary_en: R. Berish of Biala relates that R. Avraham, later rabbi of Frankfurt, possessed the holy spirit and was revealed to by Elijah, and that the Maggid of Kozhnitz saw the 13-branched menorah he installed in Karov and said a great light shone from it; this is followed by a reference to a halakhic debate on whether a seven-branched menorah is forbidden.
